therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: L-asparaginase encapsulated in erythrocytes depletes circulating asparagine
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: asparagine depletion in tumor cells that cannot synthesize asparagine
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with pancreatic adenocarcinoma receiving second-line treatment

results.effect_size: median OS 7.5 months vs 6.7 months (HR not provided)
safety_signals: more deaths from TE SAEs (14/248 vs 9/246)
gastrointestinal toxicities including obstruction, hemorrhage, diarrhea

context.comparator: chemotherapy alone (gemcitabine plus Abraxane or irinotecan plus 5-FU plus leucovorin)
